info.name: Oracle Cloud My Services Operations Resource API
Returns operation resource collection, default ordering is "id:asc".

params.name: domain
params.description: The identity domain name or the IDCS GUID of the resource

params.name: createdOnRangeEnd
params.description: Range end filter based on the createdOn attribute

params.name: createdOnRangeStart
params.description: Range start filter based on the createdOn attribute

params.name: expands
params.description: list of sub objects to expand inside the operation object, supported values: none, operationItems

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of resources to return

params.name: modifiedOnRangeEnd
params.description: Range end filter based on the modifiedOn attribute

params.name: modifiedOnRangeStart
params.description: Range start filter based on the modifiedOn attribute

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting offset of the resources to return

params.name: operationItemAttributeName
params.description: Return all operations who have an operationitem containing the specified attribute name

params.name: operationItemAttributeValue
params.description: Return all operations who have an operationitem containing the specified attribute value

params.name: operationItemCurrentActions
params.description: Comma separated list of operation item current actions, operation whose operation item current action matches one of the specified curent action will be returned.

params.name: operationItemDefinitionId
params.description: DEPRECATED, use operationItemDefinitionIds, return the operations with an operation item definition specified

params.name: operationItemDefinitionIds
params.description: Comma separated list of operation item definitions, operations whose operation item has one of the specified operation item definition ids will be returned.

params.name: operationItemId
params.description: Return the operation containing this operation item id

params.name: operationItemStatus
params.description: DEPRECATED, use operationItemStatuses, return the operations having at least one operation item with the specified status

params.name: operationItemStatuses
params.description: Comma separated list of operation item statuses, operations whose operation item status matches one of the specified operation item statuses will be returned.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Ordering of the resources, this resource can be ordered by id, createdOn, modifiedOn

params.name: status
params.description: DEPRECATED, use statuses,  operations whose status matches the specified operation status will be returned.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Comma separated list of operation statuses, operations whose status matches one of the specified operation statuses will be returned.

params.name: subSystem
params.description: Subsytem to query, currently only TRA is supported, operations from other subsystems can only be queried by id.

params.name: domain
params.description: The identity domain name or the IDCS GUID of the resource

items.docs:
The operations resource is a mean to send and monitor asynchronous operations to various Oracle Cloud Service Components. The operations consist of items defined in the operationItemDefinitions resource.

Sample for creating a new service instance

   Host: host
   Accept: application/json
